text: Cream standardised to at least 48 % fat and pasteurised. At that fat it is thick enough to spoon, whips easily and does not split in hot sauces.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Double cream is cream brought to at least 48 % fat.
The sources give no temperature for double cream, only that it is heat-treated.
Extra-thick double cream is heated and then cooled quickly.
